_comment: PresetToolKit default mapping (LooksMenu sculpts -> deformation baked into V's head). JSON with // comments allowed. Region coordinates are normalised to the head mesh bounding box: u = right (0..1), v = up (0 = bottom of neck, 1 = top of skull), w = forward (0 = back of head, 1 = tip of nose).

frame._comment: Axes of the WolvenKit GLB. WolvenKit exports Y-up. 'auto' forward finds the face side from the nose/lips profile.

gains._comment: How strongly a LooksMenu value of 1.0 deforms the CP2077 head. Use negative values to flip a direction.

_layoutComment: Meaning of each float in a LooksMenu Morphs.Regions entry. px/py/pz = position, rx/ry/rz = rotation, s = scale (FO4 axes: x right, y forward, z up).
_rangesComment: Fallout 4 facial bone region sculpt IDs (HumanRace) -> region. Single-sided sculpts (AF8B74-BF00BC) are not mapped by default; map them with idOverrides.
_fo4BonesComment: Fallback bone positions (used only for bones missing from fo4BonesFemale / fo4BonesMale below). Used when the FO4 region file is available (the game's HumanRaceFacialBoneRegions*.txt). Each sculpt moves its listed FO4 face bones by the exact Minima/Maxima amounts from that file. Locations are where each bone sits on V's head in normalised head space (u: 0 = character's left, 1 = character's right; v: 0 = bottom of neck, 1 = top of skull; w: 0 = back, 1 = nose tip), given for the right side or centre - _L_ bones are mirrored.

fo4BonesFemale._comment: Calibrated by tools/calibrate.py from BaseFemaleHead_faceBones.nif -> h0_000_pwa__morphs.morphtarget.glb (landmark fit error 6.7 mm). pivot = bone position, center/radius = skin it moves, axes = bone X/Y/Z in head space (right, up, forward).

fo4BonesMale._comment: Calibrated by tools/calibrate.py from BaseMaleHead_faceBones.nif -> h0_000_pma__morphs.morphtarget.glb (landmark fit error 9.0 mm). pivot = bone position, center/radius = skin it moves, axes = bone X/Y/Z in head space (right, up, forward).

_nameRulesComment: Used with --fo4-regions: each FO4 sculpt region's name (from HumanRaceFacialBoneRegions*.txt) is matched against these keywords at a word start, first match wins.

idOverrides._comment: Exact sculpt ID -> region, checked before the ranges. Example: "7BC80": "nose"

valueRules._comment: Morphs.Values slider IDs refer to FO4 .tri morphs and have no geometric meaning on their own. Map the ones you care about, e.g. "186B4": { "region": "nose", "translate": [0, 0.5, 0], "rotate": [0, 0, 0], "scale": 0.2 }

headDepotPath._comment: Fallback depot paths of V's head .morphtarget (the file that is replaced). Used only when the path cannot be derived from --template-morphtarget. Verify these in WolvenKit's asset browser for your game version.

headMeshDepotPath._comment: V's base head .mesh, replaced together with the .morphtarget when a head .mesh GLB is given.

commands._comment: WolvenKit.CLI command lines. Placeholders: {wolvenkit} {path} {outdir} (+ {rawdir} {pattern} for uncook, which pulls V's head out of the game's archives). Adjust if your WolvenKit version uses different verbs.

_glbNamingComment: How the raw GLB is named for WolvenKit's import. auto = like WolvenKit's own export (x.mesh -> x.glb, x.morphtarget -> x.morphtarget.glb); or withExtension / stem for everything.
_stripSkinComment: WolvenKit.CLI cannot find the morphtarget's base mesh during import (it loads no game archives) and then rejects GLBs with a skeleton. Removing the skin from the GLB used for that import keeps the vertex bone indices unchanged, which is correct for V's own head.
